stance_basis: compiled list of historic structures along alignment without expressing opposition or support
summary: Dr. Walter S. Dunn, Jr., as Director of the Buffalo Historical Society, contributed to the Section 106 historic preservation analysis by compiling a list of historic structures along the proposed rail alignment. The Historical Society also reviewed past archeological studies and supplemented them with additional information. No adverse impacts on historic structures were anticipated, and the project was found to have no effect on National Register properties.
complaint_summary: The Buffalo Historical Society, under Dr. Dunn's direction, compiled a list of historic structures along the proposed rail alignment and reviewed archeological studies, contributing technical information to the Section 106 analysis without expressing opposition to the project.
summary_quote: The Buffalo Historical Society (under the direction of Dr. Walter S. Dunn, Jr.) and the Landmark Society of the Niagara Frontier (represented by Mr. Olaf Shelgren, Jr., Chairman) compiled a list of historic structures located along the proposed rail alignment.
